_description: KPI dependency map — which downstream engines depend on each KPI. Used by configure_customer_kpis to warn when disabling load-bearing KPIs.
_source: Derived from power_of_1_economics.json linked_kpi_codes + arc_classifier rules

P1-KPI1.warning: Disabling P1-KPI1 (Time-to-First-Workload) degrades TTFV projection in ROI engine

P2-KPI1.warning: Disabling P2-KPI1 (RMA Frequency Rate) degrades ticket resolution time projection

P2-KPI2.warning: Disabling P2-KPI2 (MTBF) degrades ticket resolution time projection

P2-KPI3.warning: Disabling P2-KPI3 (Critical Incidents) degrades GRR projection

P3-KPI1.warning: Disabling P3-KPI1 (GPU Utilization) degrades product adoption projection and arc classification

P3-KPI2.warning: Disabling P3-KPI2 (Training Job Completion) degrades product adoption projection

P3-KPI3.warning: Disabling P3-KPI3 (Inference Latency) degrades product adoption projection

P4-KPI1.warning: Disabling P4-KPI1 (Partner Engagement) degrades GRR projection

P4-KPI2.warning: Disabling P4-KPI2 (VAR Performance) degrades GRR projection

P4-KPI3.warning: Disabling P4-KPI3 (Joint QBR Frequency) degrades NRR projection

P5-KPI1.warning: Disabling P5-KPI1 (Capacity Utilization) degrades NRR and expansion rate projections — high impact on ROI story

P5-KPI2.warning: Disabling P5-KPI2 (Capacity Utilization Trajectory) degrades NRR projection

P5-KPI3.warning: Disabling P5-KPI3 (Workload Growth Velocity) degrades expansion rate projection

P1.warning: Disabling P1 (Deployment Velocity) removes TTFV from ROI projections

P2.warning: Disabling P2 (Operational Stability) removes ticket resolution and partially degrades GRR projections

P3.warning: Disabling P3 (AI Workload Performance) removes product adoption projection and weakens arc classification

P4.warning: Disabling P4 (Channel & Partner Health) degrades GRR and NRR projections

P5.warning: Disabling P5 (Expansion Readiness) removes NRR and expansion rate projections — major ROI impact
